toolSetSelection: Every accepted compiler names the MSVC tool set it belongs to. A host qualifies with exactly one reviewed tool set whose installed cl.exe has the exact reviewed bytes, file version and Microsoft signature. The shared inputs.lock.json keeps naming the first reviewed tool set and is not the source of the tool set that is used.
qualification: Exact Microsoft-signed executable hash and file version, pinned MSVC/SDK, two fresh native outputs and immutable package entry verification. Actual producer provenance stays outside the portable package manifest.
